items.exampleEn: The instructions in the box were short and unhelpful.
items.exampleZh: 盒子裡的說明書又短又沒幫助。

items.exampleEn: After the long flight, tiredness hit me all at once.
items.exampleZh: 長途飛行後，疲倦一下子全湧了上來。

items.exampleEn: My cheeky nephew put salt in my coffee as a joke.
items.exampleZh: 我那調皮的姪子開玩笑地在我的咖啡裡加鹽。

items.exampleEn: "What a beautiful garden!" she said admiringly.
The bookish professor rarely left his office.
items.exampleZh: 那位愛讀書的教授很少離開他的辦公室。

items.exampleEn: Some people believe that being shy is inborn.
items.exampleZh: 有些人認為害羞是天生的。

items.exampleEn: His impolite reply surprised everyone at the table.
items.exampleZh: 他沒禮貌的回答讓同桌的人都很驚訝。

items.exampleEn: Good manners dignify even a simple meal.
items.exampleZh: 良好的禮儀讓一頓簡單的飯也顯得莊重。
items.glossZh: 使顯得莊重；把…當一回事

items.sentenceEn: She has an inborn talent for drawing animals.

items.audioEn: The man at the ticket office was unhelpful, so we asked a guard for directions.
items.audioZh: 售票處的男子不肯幫忙，所以我們向一位警衛問路。

items.sentenceEn: The crowd looked admiringly at the young violin player.
items.sentenceZh: 群眾讚賞地看著那位年輕的小提琴手。

items.sentenceEn: Tiredness can make drivers react more slowly.
items.sentenceZh: 疲勞會讓駕駛人反應變慢。

items.stemEn: My little brother was ____ to our guests and didn't even say hello.
items.stemZh: 我弟弟對客人很沒禮貌，連招呼都沒打。

items.stemEn: The ____ boy asked the teacher if he could have her piece of cake too.
items.stemZh: 那個厚臉皮的男孩問老師，能不能連她那塊蛋糕也給他。

items.passageEn: Last summer, my bookish cousin Mei worked at a small bookstore. Most customers were friendly, but some were impolite and complained loudly when a book was sold out. Mei refused to dignify their rude comments with an angry answer. The other worker was often unhelpful, so she had to do most of the work, and by evening her tiredness was easy to see. Still, she felt proud when an old customer bought one of the bookmarks she had made by hand and looked at it admiringly.
items.passageZh: 去年夏天，我那愛讀書的表妹 Mei 在一家小書店打工。大部分客人都很友善，但有些人很沒禮貌，書賣完了就大聲抱怨。Mei 不屑用生氣的話去回應那些無禮的言論。另一位店員常常不幫忙，所以大部分的工作都落在她身上，到了傍晚，她的疲倦一看就知道。不過，當一位老顧客買了一張她親手做的書籤、還讚賞地看著它時，她覺得很驕傲。

questions.questionZh: Mei 為什麼要做大部分的工作？
options: 另一位店員常常不幫忙

questions.questionZh: 什麼事讓 Mei 覺得驕傲？

items.promptZh: 嘴裡塞滿食物時說話是不禮貌的。
referenceEn: It is impolite to talk with your mouth full.
Talking with your mouth full of food is impolite.
rubricZh: 要用 impolite（例如 It is impolite to…、is impolite）
「嘴裡塞滿食物」可寫，例如 with your mouth full 等

items.instructionZh: 用 bookish 造一個句子，描述你自己或身邊一個愛讀書的人。
referenceEn: I was a bookish child and always carried a novel with me.
My bookish roommate reads three books a week.
rubricZh: 句子要用到 bookish（例如 a bookish child、my bookish roommate）
時態配合內容（例如 was、reads 等）

resolvedAfterFinalReview.message: 第②關 issue 結案：英文不自然："shy feelings are inborn"——shy feelings 不是道地說法，應為 "shyness is inborn" 或 "some people are born shy"。
